subject: Headcount sprint proposal + prioritized backfills (QBR alignment)
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Headcount sprint proposal + prioritized backfills (QBR alignment)

Team,

As we prep for the QBR deck next week I want to propose a short, targeted hiring sprint to lock down critical coverage for product and infra before the end of the quarter. The ask is narrowly scoped: up to 3 backfills that unblock delivery on Q3 customer commitments and 1 high-priority growth hire subject to exec sign-off.

Attached is a simple scenario sheet (Headcount_scenarios_QBR_v2.xlsx) with three options:
- Option A: Minimal (2 backfills, no net new) — aligns to 90% of roadmap but delays one feature.
- Option B: Focused (3 backfills + 1 critical net-new) — preserves roadmap and controls runway.
- Option C: Freeze (backfills only considered for mission-critical roles) — saves ~10% of spend.

Immediate asks:
1) Can Michael & Vanessa confirm which option you prefer by EOD Wednesday?
2) Karthik, can you fast-track procurement for the two backfill reqs if we land on Option B? I’ve attached the draft REQ-4587 for the infra backfill for your intake.

Rationale: with the new Redwood Dedicated accounts ramping, the infra backfill is the gating item for predictable latency SLO work (we're seeing variance in capacity planning). This sprint is not a broad hiring push — it’s surgical.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Principal PM, Core Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Headcount_scenarios_QBR_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount sprint proposal + prioritized backfills (QBR alignment)

Logan — thanks for pulling this together. I prefer Option B (Focused). Two quick things:
- Please prioritize REQ-4587 (infra backfill) and REQ-4590 (senior product engineer backfill, attached in my notes). Those two unblock the deployment cadence we promised to Acme Cloud.
- If we push the net-new hire, it should be scoped to a senior growth engineer on the platform team — not a general IC.

I'll cascade to the people managers and ask them to freeze other open reqs for the week so we can concentrate on these.

V.

--
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Engineering (Platform)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: procurement <acme.cloud.procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 12:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount sprint proposal + prioritized backfills (QBR alignment)

Adding procurement looped in so we can get a quick vendor/contract path for the backfills if we need contingent support.

Logan / Vanessa — I reviewed REQ-4587 and it looks good from JDs and level. I attached the intake PDF (REQ-4587-backfill.pdf) to this thread for completeness. For speed, procurement can approve a 60-day contractor arrangement by Wednesday if you want to start interviews immediately; otherwise we can go the direct hire route which will take ~3 extra weeks.

Procurement (acme.cloud.procurement@acmecloud.com) — can you confirm the fastest path assuming Option B and 2 contractor starts next week? Please confirm fees and any onboarding constraints.

-Karthik

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount sprint proposal + prioritized backfills (QBR alignment)

Team — good framing. I support Option B with a constraint: approve the 2 backfills (REQ-4587, REQ-4590) immediately; hold the net-new for a final sign-off after the QBR slide accountability discussion. Two conditions:
1) Managers provide quick acceptance criteria for the backfills' 30/60/90 outcomes (so we can measure impact).
2) Cost: Karthik, route the backfill hires as contractors for 60 days if that reduces time-to-start; convert to perm only with demonstrated impact.

Please document decisions in the shared sheet and I'll sign the approval note Thursday morning so HR can start offers.

Michael Grant
Chief Product Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Headcount sprint proposal + prioritized backfills (QBR alignment)

Thanks all — quick summarizing note and next steps: 

Decision: Move forward with Option B (Focused). Approvals: Michael — verbal approval pending your sign-off on Thursday AM (per your note).
Action items (owners / timing):
- Vanessa: finalize 30/60/90 outcomes for REQ-4587 (infra) and REQ-4590 (product) by EOD Thursday.
- Karthik: confirm procurement contractor path and fees with Acme procurement by Thursday noon.
- Talent: (talentpartners@hiringco.com) — standby to kick off contractor search; scope: 60-day contractor, immediate start.
- Logan: prepare QBR slide with conservative spend delta and impact metrics (I'll publish to the linked sheet).

I attached the intake PDF again for tracking. I’ll move the two reqs to priority status in Lever and flag for accelerated screening.

Thanks — quick and surgical.

Logan Wright
Principal PM, Core Platform
Redwood Inference
